name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.245.0 — Plan cites a behaviour contract and the build replays it: /spec:plan takes design/prototypes/<stem>/contract.json and stamps prototype: <stem> on the specs it writes; the build driver's behaviour lane is one REPLAY state that copies the contract's tests into the tree, runs the host's e2eRun against the production build, and waits for a literal close enough beside the prototype pictures; review gains a contract leg read off the build row; the review close runs the prototype's --mark closed when the last citing spec is done and /spec:status prints that paste as a hygiene item. The harden merge, the structural capture and the open-proto-branch admission refusal are deleted. 7.244.0 — The prototype opens from words, a brief or a stem: /spec:prototype takes an idea in plain words (stem derived as a slug, printed as an auto-pick, renamable once with --stem before opened), a roadmap brief path, or an existing prototype stem; status.json records the input kind and the idea at opened, a words prototype stamps brief n/a, and the missing prototype-block refusal says what the block is for. The Lane: behaviour gate is gone from plan and prototype — Lane is advisory and rounds run with no gate. 7.243.0 — Approve writes a behaviour contract (specs/20261007/01): the prototype freeze is retired — --mark contracted pictures every route × state through the host's own prototype.picture command and writes contract.json; --mark tests-derived requires one end-to-end test per behaviour pin that the runner lists and that passes against the prototype, copies it into design/prototypes/<stem>/tests/, records a ledger row and queues the /spec:plan paste; the worktree and branch stay until --mark closed. No gate, no export, no generated spec. The grounding contract § Prototype changed (export, gate and storageState gone; e2eRun and picture added), so the contract hash changed and hosts owe a /spec:doctor re-stamp.
